from flymyai import client, FlyMyAIPredictException

payload = {
    "moderation": None,
    "quality": "medium",
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "image": pathlib.Path("/path/to/your/file.jpg")
}

fma_client = client(apikey=apikey)
try:
    response = fma_client.predict(
        model=model,
        payload=payload
    )
    print(f"image: {response.output_data['image']}")
except FlyMyAIPredictException as e:
    print(e)
    raise e
